parts.text: Ethanol can be made by fermentation of sugars found in plants. A by-product of fermentation is carbon dioxide gas. A student made some ethanol using the following method. step 1 Cut up some sugar cane and crush it. step 2 Add hot water to the sugar cane and stir to dissolve the sugar in the sugar cane. step 3 Remove the solids from the mixture to obtain sugar solution. step 4 Let the sugar solution cool and then add yeast. step 5 Place the mixture obtained in the apparatus shown in Fig. 1.1. step 6 Leave the apparatus until fermentation is complete.
